test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Dr. Avesh Kumar Tyagi, the recipient of Vigyan Shri Award 2024 in the field of Atomic Energy, is associated with which of the following institutes as of 01 November 2024?

options.text: Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology (RRCAT), Indore
Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR), Kalpakkam

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Avesh Kumar Tyagi** is associated with the **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Mumbai**.
 
• **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)** is India's premier nuclear research facility, headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• Bhabha Atomic Research Centre was established in **1954** by Dr. **Homi Jehangir Bhabha**, the father of India's nuclear program.
 
• BARC conducts research and development in **nuclear science, engineering, and related areas**.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in the development of nuclear energy and technology in India, including the design and construction of nuclear reactors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology (RRCAT), Indore**__

 __
 
• The **Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology (RRCAT)** is located in **Indore, Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• RRCAT is involved in research and development in the areas of **accelerator technologies** and **laser technologies**.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR), Kalpakkam**__
 __
 
• The **Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR)** is situated in **Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• IGCAR specializes in the development of **fast breeder reactor technology**.
 
 
 
• **Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre (VECC), Kolkata**__
 
 
• The **Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre (VECC)** is based in **Kolkata, West Bengal**.
 
• VECC is primarily focused on research in the field of **accelerator-based science and nuclear physics**.
